Über uns
Rain for Rent International ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen und spezialisiert auf Lösungen im Bereich temporäres Flüssigkeitsmanagement. Mit Standorten in Deutschland, den Niederlanden, Frankreich und dem Vereinigten Königreich unterstützen wir unsere Kunden mit innovativen Lösungen in den Bereichen Tankvermietung, Pumpen, Filtration und Rückhaltung.
Unsere Kunden kommen aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen, darunter Chemie, Energie, Infrastruktur, Fertigung, Umwelttechnik und Bauwesen. Sicherheit, Kundenorientierung und technische Kompetenz stehen dabei im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns.
Zur Unterstützung unseres weiteren Wachstums in Europa suchen wir einen engagierten Business Development Manager (m/w/d) für die Region Süddeutschland.

Warum Rain for Rent International?
Bei Rain for Rent International werden Sie Teil eines Unternehmens mit über 90 Jahren Erfahrung im Bereich temporärer Flüssigkeitsmanagement-Lösungen.
Wir bieten Ihnen ein unternehmerisches Umfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative geschätzt wird und Sie die Möglichkeit haben, aktiv zum Wachstum unseres europäischen Geschäfts beizutragen. Wenn Sie Freude daran haben, Kunden zu begeistern, neue Märkte zu erschließen und in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten, freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.
Rain for Rent International steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen aller qualifizierten Personen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, ethnischer oder sozialer Herkunft, Religion oder Weltanschauung, sexueller Orientierung oder Identität.
Sollten Sie im Rahmen des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung oder eine angemessene Anpassung benötigen, teilen Sie uns dies bitte mit. Wir setzen uns für einen fairen und barrierefreien Bewerbungsprozess ein.

Who we are: Action1 is an autonomous endpoint management platform trusted by thousands of organizations, including many Fortune 500 companies. Cloud-native, infinitely scalable, highly secure, and configurable in 5 minutes—it just works and is always free for the first 200 endpoints, with no functional limits.

By pioneering autonomous OS and third-party patching with peer-to-peer patch distribution and real-time vulnerability assessment without needing a VPN, it eliminates routine labor, preempts ransomware and security risks, and protects the digital employee experience.

In 2025, Action1 was recognized by Inc. 5000 as the fastest-growing private software company in America. The company is founder-led by Alex Vovk and Mike Walters, American entrepreneurs who previously founded Netwrix, a multi-billion-dollar cybersecurity company. Introduction:  Action1 is transforming endpoint security for modern IT teams.

As we continue our evolution from SMB to enterprise, we are hiring a high-performing Enterprise Account Executive to drive complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across mid-market and enterprise organizations in the UK. This is a quota-carrying, full-cycle role focused on landing and expanding enterprise accounts.

You will engage directly with IT Directors, Security Leaders, Infrastructure teams, and executive stakeholders to position Action1 ’s patch management and endpoint security platform as a strategic solution.

We’re looking for someone who understands how enterprise cybersecurity buying works — longer sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, technical validation, procurement navigation — and who thrives in a high-growth, remote-first SaaS environment.

If you’ve successfully sold cybersecurity or adjacent IT solutions into enterprise accounts and enjoy building pipelines as much as closing, this role is for you. Responsibilities: Drive Enterprise Revenue Growth: Own a defined territory and meet or exceed enterprise quota targets through disciplined pipeline generation and deal execution.

Manage the Full Sales Cycle: Lead opportunities from prospecting through close — including discovery, stakeholder mapping, value alignment, proof-of-concept coordination, negotiation, and contract execution.

Sell to IT & Security Leaders: Engage IT Managers, Directors of Infrastructure, CISOs, and technical buying committees with credibility and consultative expertise. Build & Maintain Strong Pipeline Coverage: Generate pipeline through outbound prospecting, partner collaboration, and strategic account planning.

Maintain disciplined forecasting and opportunity hygiene in Salesforce. Navigate Complex Buying Processes: Manage multi-threaded sales cycles, security reviews, procurement workflows, and competitive displacement strategies.

Partner with Solutions Engineers: Collaborate closely with pre-sales/technical resources to ensure strong technical validation and alignment with customer requirements. Execute Account Expansion Strategy: Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within enterprise customers to drive expansion revenue and long-term retention.

Stay Market-Aware: Maintain strong knowledge of cybersecurity trends, endpoint management landscape, and competitive positioning. Operate with Ownership: Work independently in a remote-first environment while collaborating cross-functionally with Marketing, Channel, Customer Success, and Product teams.

Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner closely with marketing, product, and sales leadership to provide feedback from the field and refine messaging.

Requirements 3+ years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience in SaaS/ Cybersecurity Proven success selling into mid-market or enterprise organizations Experience engaging IT buyers (IT Directors, SysAdmins, Security Leaders, Infrastructure teams) Demonstrated ability to generate pipeline and close complex deals Strong forecasting discipline and Salesforce hygiene Experience navigating longer, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles Excellent discovery and consultative selling skills Comfortable in a high-growth, fast-paced remote environment Benefits A collaborative environment encouraging you to own your domain and implement best practices Stable income, benefits, flexible working hours, and opportunities for promotion.

Who is Eleos Health ?
Today, more people than ever are speaking publicly about their mental health. Whether it's ourselves, our friends and family or even public figures, taking care of your behavioral health is no longer a taboo, it's vital, and it's only human. Eleos is on a mission to help deliver the world's most effective behavioral care through data, measurement, and personalization. Or simply put, we want to give clinicians the support they need to do the important work only they can do .

This role blends account management and consultative sales, giving you the opportunity to deepen customer partnerships while driving revenue growth by selling new products, features, and expansions.

You’ll work closely with healthcare stakeholders and internal teams to help customers achieve meaningful outcomes while expanding their use of our platform. Who you are: You are a relationship-first, growth-minded professional who enjoys working with existing customers and identifying ways to deliver more value.

You’re comfortable having strategic conversations with clinical, operational, and executive stakeholders and know how to balance trust-building with revenue responsibility. You thrive in fast-paced startup environments, take ownership of your work, and are motivated by both customer success and business impact. How will you contribute:
Manage and grow a book with significant ARR expansion responsibility
Collaborate with internal teams including Product, CS Ops, Support, and Implementation to resolve issues and deliver improvements
Drive customer retention, adoption, and long-term account health
Navigate multi-stakeholder sales cycles spanning clinical, operational, and RCM/billing audiences.
Sell new products, modules, and features aligned to customer needs and outcomes
Manage expansion opportunities through the full sales cycle and meet or exceed growth targets
Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and expansion quota ownership
Own renewals end-to-end, including contract discussions and pricing conversations
Develop account plans aligned to customer goals and Eleos growth objectives

s.h: Who Is Wrike and Our Culture
s.t:
We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
Hybrid work mode
Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.
Our persona
💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.
💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

🤩 Customer-Focused
We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.
🤝 Collaborative
We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.
🎨 Creative
We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

What is Restaurant Software?
Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

Acceler8 Labs is where growth gets personal.
We’re a growth marketing company founded by two former Facebookers who decided to build something better after seeing the gap between traditional agencies and the real needs of modern brands.
We believe scale isn’t about bigger budgets but smarter decisions. Our team has helped brands across the globe generate over $1 billion in revenue by combining sharp strategy, bold creativity, and hands-on execution.
We’re designed for the digital era, where everything evolves at the speed of light. Our work evolves alongside it, adapting to the industries, platforms, and audiences we help grow.
We partner with some of the world’s fastest-growing brands, from disruptive startups to global household names, to turn marketing spend into measurable business growth.

We’re looking for a full-time Business Development Manager who can turn great work into consistent growth.
You’ll take qualified opportunities and turn them into long-term client relationships, leading conversations from discovery through to proposal, negotiation, and close. You’ll speak directly with founders, CMOs, Heads of Growth, and other senior decision-makers, digging into how their businesses actually grow and where Acceler8 can make a meaningful difference.
This is a senior, sales-focused role for someone who understands growth marketing beyond the campaign level. You’ll connect paid media, creative, conversion, retention, and measurement to the commercial realities of a business, then translate those opportunities into a compelling reason to work with Acceler8.
You’ll support the top of funnel through prospecting and lead generation, as well as Acceler8’s founders and leadership team on high-value opportunities, proposals, pricing, and closing strategy.

s.h: As a Business Development Manager, you will
s.t:
Take ownership of qualified opportunities, leading the sales process from discovery through to proposal, negotiation, and close
Lead thoughtful discovery conversations with founders, CMOs, Heads of Growth, and other senior decision-makers to understand their business objectives, growth constraints, marketing challenges, and commercial priorities
Look beyond individual campaigns to understand the broader business, including customer acquisition, retention, AOV, CAC or CPA, LTV, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, channel mix, and profitability
Identify where Acceler8 can create meaningful value across paid media, creative strategy, measurement, conversion, channel expansion, or broader growth strategy
Navigate conversations with prospects who may already have an internal marketing team or agency partner, building a credible case for why a different approach may drive stronger results
Develop and present tailored proposals that connect Acceler8’s services directly to the prospect’s business goals and growth opportunities
Partner closely with our Growth Development Representative on lead quality, Ideal Customer Profile refinement, prospect insights, and opportunities moving through the pipeline
Collaborate with Acceler8’s leadership team on sales strategy, pricing, proposals, and high-value opportunities
Maintain disciplined CRM management and accurate visibility across opportunities, conversion, expected revenue, and pipeline health
Use HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Google Workspace, and other sales and prospecting tools to research opportunities and maintain an organized sales process
Represent Acceler8 at conferences, dinners, networking events, and other opportunities to build relationships and strengthen our presence in the market

s.h: You’ll thrive in this role if you
s.t:
Have 5-10 years of experience in business development or sales, including at least 3 years working within a media, advertising, performance marketing, ecommerce, or growth-focused agency environment
Have sold marketing or agency services and understand how DTC and ecommerce businesses grow, not simply how individual advertising campaigns are managed
Can confidently discuss metrics such as revenue, AOV, CAC or CPA, LTV, MER, ROAS, conversion rate, retention, and contribution margin, and understand how they connect to the economics of a business
Understand how paid media fits into a broader growth strategy spanning creative, conversion, retention, promotions, merchandising, CRM, organic channels, marketplaces, and other acquisition channels
Can look at a business, ask intelligent questions, identify potential growth constraints, and translate those challenges into opportunities Acceler8 may be able to solve
Are a strong consultative seller who can build credibility with founders and senior marketing leaders without relying on a scripted pitch
Are comfortable selling into organizations that may already have an agency or internal marketing team and navigating the complexity involved in making a change
Have experience using a modern sales stack, including CRM, lead sourcing, enrichment, LinkedIn prospecting, and pipeline reporting
Have a builder’s mindset and are comfortable being hands-on across research, discovery, proposals, follow-up, negotiation, and closing
Are curious, strategic, tenacious, and organized, and care about winning the right clients and building relationships that last
Live in the US (we’re a remote-first team)
Why Acceler8 Labs ?
We built Acceler8 to bridge the gap between agencies and brands, replacing complexity with clarity and collaboration.
Our model is rooted in three pillars: Fuel (media), Spark (creative), and Insight (analytics), each designed to move faster, think smarter, and deliver measurable impact.
Here you’ll have the room to experiment, fail fast, and learn even faster. Your ideas won’t get lost in a Slack thread. You’ll be part of a team that values transparency, curiosity, and craftsmanship.
We take care of our people so they can take care of their work, their families, and themselves.

Remote workdays so you can design a schedule that works for your rhythm

Learning and certification opportunities to help you grow your craft, not just your title
Real autonomy because we believe in hiring smart people and giving them the space to do great work
The chance to build something that scales for our clients, and for you
If you’re ready to lead a team that’s redefining what performance marketing looks like, we’d love to chat.

Deine Aufgaben Du weißt, dass du zu den Besten gehörst. Dein Umfeld weiß es auch. Aber deine aktuelle Rolle gibt dir nicht mehr den Raum, den du verdienst. Du hast in den letzten Jahren Deals geschlossen, die andere für unmöglich hielten.

Du kennst das SAP-Ökosystem nicht aus Präsentationen – sondern aus echten Co-Sell-Gesprächen, aus Partnerverhandlungen, aus Abschlüssen, die du persönlich über die Linie gebracht hast. Jetzt fragst du dich: Gibt es eine Rolle, die meinem Anspruch wirklich gerecht wird? Die gibt es. Und du liest sie gerade.
Die Rolle
Dies ist eine reine New-Business-Position mit klarer strategischer Bedeutung für Implicos Wachstum in SAP-zentrierten Prozessindustrien. Du verantwortest die Gewinnung neuer Kundenlogos in den Segmenten Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie sowie Zement und Baustoffe – in enger Co-Sell-Partnerschaft mit SAP Account Teams und Industry Business Units.  Du bewegst dich in einem Umfeld, in dem Vertrauen, Substanz und Marktkenntnisse entscheiden – nicht Lautstärke.
Deine Verantwortung
Vollständige Quota-Verantwortung für neues ARR aus Prozessindustrie-Kunden
Identifikation und Qualifizierung von Opportunities aus der SAP-ADRM-Pipeline sowie dem eigenen Netzwerk
Aufbau und Pflege belastbarer Co-Sell-Beziehungen mit SAP SCM Sales Reps und IBU-Kontakten
Steuerung komplexer Sales-Zyklen von 3–9 Monaten mit mehreren Entscheidungsträgern auf IT-, Operations- und C-Level-Ebene
Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Solution Architects für technische Deep Dives und Proof-of-Value-Definitionen
Akkurate Pipeline-Führung im CRM sowie strukturiertes Forecasting
Kontinuierliche Rückmeldung von Markt- und Wettbewerbsinformationen an Product- und GTM-Teams

Mindestens 5 Jahre B2B-Softwarevertrieb, davon mindestens 3 Jahre im SAP-Umfeld oder im strukturierten Co-Sell mit SAP
Nachweisliche Hunter-Bilanz: nachhaltig neue Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut und abgeschlossen – nicht primär im Bestandsgeschäft
Tiefes Verständnis der SAP Channel- und Co-Sell-Mechanismen: Partnerdeals, RISE/GROW-Pipeline, SAP-Partnerökosystem
Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Multi-Stakeholder-Prozessen auf Entscheiderebene
Souveränes Auftreten auf C-Level – verbindlich, präzise, auf Augenhöhe
Ausgeprägte Eigenständigkeit in einem frühen, sich entwickelnden Go-to-Market-Setup
Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch

Branchenwissen in Landwirtschaft, Bergbau, Chemie oder Zement/Baustoffe
Bestehendes Netzwerk in der SAP SCM- oder Logistik-IBU-Community
Erfahrung im Vertrieb von SAP-Add-ons oder SolEx-Produkten
Vertrautheit mit Supply-Chain-Execution-, TM- oder Bulk-Logistik-Prozessen
Was du bei uns findest
Eine strategisch bedeutsame Rolle mit direktem Einfluss auf das Unternehmenswachstum
Klare Ziele, volle Autonomie in der Ausführung – kein Mikromanagement
Ungedeckeltes Vergütungsmodell – dein Upside spiegelt deinen Beitrag
Direkter Zugang zum SAP-Ökosystem und enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Solution Architects
Ein Umfeld, das Seniorität respektiert und Eigenverantwortung erwartet
Du gestaltest – nicht nur mit. Du gestaltest, wie es wird.
Implico ist kein fertig gebautes Konstrukt, das auf einen weiteren Vertriebsmitarbeiter wartet. Diese Rolle ist eine der ersten ihrer Art – du definierst mit, wie wir in den Prozessindustrien wahrgenommen werden, wie wir co-sellen, wie wir skalieren. Was du heute aufbaust, bleibt. Dein Fingerabdruck ist sichtbar – in der Kundenbasis, in der Marktpositionierung, in der Art, wie das Team in zwei Jahren arbeitet. Das ist kein Job. Das ist ein Gestaltungsauftrag.
Das Team – kein Versprechen, sondern eine Einladung.
"Tolles Team" steht in jeder Stellenanzeige. Das überspringst du längst. Deshalb sagen wir es anders: Schau dir an, mit wem du zusammenarbeiten würdest. Mark, Maurice, Anna, Thales, Selina und mehr. Menschen, die nicht wegen des Titels hier sind. Die morgens mit echtem Interesse an ihre Arbeit gehen.

Die füreinander einspringen, ohne dass jemand fragen muss. Die über ihre Themen sprechen, als wären es ihre eigenen Projekte – weil sie es sind. Keine perfekte Hochglanz-Kultur. Aber eine, in der Leidenschaft und Haltung mehr zählen als Hierarchie. Ob das zu dir passt? Das findest du nur heraus, wenn du das Gespräch suchst.
Der nächste Schritt
Wenn du in den letzten Jahren bewiesen hast, dass du im SAP-Umfeld neue Märkte erschließt und Abschlüsse bringst dann freuen wir uns auf ein erstes, offenes Gespräch.  Kein langes Anschreiben. Zeig uns deinen Track Record – der Rest ergibt sich.

Wir machen Medienmachende. Das MAZ ist das führende Kompetenzzentrum für Journalismus und Kommunikation direkt beim Bahnhof Luzern. Als Stiftung unterstützt durch verschiedene namhafte Träger im Medienbereich sorgen wir für die Ausbildung von Berufseinsteigerinnen und Berufseinsteigern, bilden Medienschaffende weiter und trainieren Kommunikationsverantwortliche und Führungskräfte.
Im Zuge der laufenden Organisationsentwicklung suchen wir eine engagierte und selbständige Persönlichkeit als
**Key Account Manager:in**
**Ihre Rolle**
Als Key Account Manager:in am MAZ bauen Sie unsere aktive Kundenakquise insbesondere für massgeschneiderte Angebote auf und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter. Sie identifizieren neue Kund:innen und Marktbedürfnisse und bauen langfristige Beziehungen auf. Von der ersten Kontaktaufnahme über die Offerte bis zum Abschluss sorgen Sie dafür, dass aus Kundenbedürfnissen konkrete Aufträge werden.
**Ihre Verantwortung**
* **Marktbearbeitung:** Sie sprechen Unternehmen, Verwaltungen, öffentliche Institutionen, staatsnahe Betriebe, Verbände, Non\-Profit\-Organisationen, Kommunikationsabteilungen und Medienhäuser aktiv an und gewinnen neue Kund:innen.
* **Kund:innenentwicklung:** Sie identifizieren und qualifizieren Leads, führen Erst\- und Bedarfsgespräche und bauen, in enger Abstimmung mit der CEO, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.
* **Angebotsentwicklung:** Sie übersetzen Kundenbedürfnisse gemeinsam mit unserem Chief Product Officer (CPO) und Studienleitungen in passende Weiterbildungsangebote.
* **Offerten \& Abschlüsse:** Sie erstellen und kalkulieren Offerten, fassen systematisch nach und gewinnen neue Aufträge und Wiederholungsaufträge.
* **Sales\-Funnel \& CRM:** Sie bauen einen professionellen Sales\-Funnel auf, pflegen Kund:innendaten und sorgen für klare und verbindliche Nachfassprozesse.
* **Marktfeedback:** Sie bringen Erkenntnisse aus Kund:innengesprächen ins MAZ zurück und liefern damit wichtige Impulse für die Weiterentwicklung und Positionierung unserer Angebote.
* **Kundenbetreuung:** Sie begleiten die Kund:innen vom Erstkontakt bis zur Übergabe an CPO, Studienleitungen und Administration und sorgen für eine konsistente Kundenerfahrung.
**Das bringen Sie mit**
**1\. Verkauf \& Kundenentwicklung**
* **B2B\-Erfahrung:** Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Erfahrung im B2B\-Verkauf, Business Development, Key Account Management oder in der beratungsnahen Kund:innenentwicklung, idealerweise in der Medien\- und Kommunikationsbranche.
* **Beratungskompetenz:** Sie erkennen Kundenbedürfnisse, strukturieren diese und entwickeln daraus gemeinsam mit unseren Fachpersonen konkrete Lösungen.
* **Beziehungsmanagement:** Sie wissen, wie langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufgebaut, gepflegt und weiterentwickelt werden.
* **Abschlussstärke:** Sie haben Freude an aktiver Marktbearbeitung, verfolgen Offerten konsequent und orientieren sich an messbaren Ergebnissen.
**2\. Markt\- \& Angebotsverständnis**
* **Weiterbildung \& Kommunikation:** Sie interessieren sich für Themen wie Journalismus, Kommunikation, KI, Medienkompetenz, Auftrittskompetenz und Weiterbildung.
* **Konzeptionelles Denken:** Sie können Kund:innenbedürfnisse in passgenaue Angebote übersetzen und arbeiten dafür eng mit internen Fachpersonen zusammen.
* **Sales\-Prozesse:** Erfahrung mit CRM, Sales\-Funnel, Pipeline\-Steuerung und systematischer Angebotsnachfassung ist von Vorteil.
* **Kommunikation:** Sie kommunizieren schriftlich und mündlich stilsicher und erstellen überzeugende Offerten, Angebotsunterlagen und Kundenkorrespondenz.
**3\. Persönlichkeit**
* **Kund:innenorientierung:** Sie haben ein ausgeprägtes Dienstleistungsverständnis und treten gegenüber Geschäftsleitungen, HR, Kommunikationsverantwortlichen und öffentlichen Institutionen souverän auf.
* **Unternehmerisches Denken:** Sie erkennen Chancen, gehen aktiv auf potenzielle Kunden zu und haben Freude daran, neue Märkte zu entwickeln.
* **Verbindlichkeit:** Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert und beharrlich und behalten Ihre Pipeline im Blick.
* **Teamorientierung:** Sie arbeiten eng mit der CEO, CPO, Studienleitungen, Marketing, Administration und weiteren Fachpersonen zusammen und verstehen Verkauf als gemeinsame Aufgabe.
**Das bieten wir Ihnen**
* Die Möglichkeit, die Marktbearbeitung des MAZ aktiv mit aufzubauen und zu professionalisieren.
* Viel Gestaltungsspielraum an der Schnittstelle von Verkauf, Weiterbildung, Journalismus und Kommunikation.
* Ein breites Netzwerk aus Medien, Unternehmen, Verwaltungen und öffentlichen Institutionen.
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsleitung, Marketing sowie unseren Studienleitungen und ausgewiesenen Fachpersonen.
* Einen Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von Luzern sowie regelmässigen direkten Kontakt mit Kund:innen in der Deutschschweiz und künftig schweizweit.

💬 Accurx is solving healthcare productivity for the NHS.
For decades, the NHS has struggled with fragmented systems that make simple tasks feel impossible. At Accurx, we’re changing that by building a single, system-wide platform that helps every patient get gold-standard, efficient, and joined-up care.
What started as a way for GPs to text a patient has now evolved into an all-in-one digital toolkit used by 98% of GP practices.
Our platform now powers Total Triage to manage patient demand, and Self-Book , which lets patients schedule their own appointments in seconds. We’ve automated routine care with Patient Questionnaires for long-term conditions, while Accumail finally allows staff-to-staff communication to happen instantly across different care settings. We’re now pushing the boundaries of the consultation itself with Accurx Scribe , our AI-powered note-taker that drafts medical notes in real-time.
We’re not just shipping features. We’re giving clinicians their time back and ensuring every patient journey is as smooth as it should be.

Most of our growth so far has happened in England. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland are three separate health systems, each with its own clinical systems, procurement routes, information governance rules and digital strategy, and none of them have an ICB layer to sell into. This role owns all three.
It is a genuinely blank page. You work out what winning looks like in each nation, then build the repeatable way to do it, selling everything from a single practice subscription to a health board wide agreement.
Owning three health systems, not one region: building pipeline across Scottish and Welsh health boards, clusters, PCNs, GP federations and HSC Trusts in Northern Ireland, and adapting your approach to the structures that actually exist in each.
Selling at every level: running fast, high volume practice level deals alongside long, multi stakeholder board and national negotiations, and knowing which one you are in.
Winning the technical argument: these deals are frequently won or lost on integration. You will hold your own with eHealth teams, IG leads and national bodies on clinical systems, APIs, deployment routes and assurance, without waiting for an engineer to join the call.
Turning pilots into contracts: generating credible local evidence and then converting it into paid, scaled agreements rather than letting it stall as a permanent trial.
Using data to pick your battles: building the territory model from list sizes, usage, adoption and pipeline data, and using it to decide where a national deal is realistic and where practice by practice is the faster path.
Building the playbook: leaving behind documented, repeatable go to market approaches per nation, so this patch scales beyond you.
You should apply if...
You are a proven deal-closer with a track record of carrying your own number and consistently hitting it.
You are comfortable at both ends of the deal size range, equally credible on a quick practice level close and a twelve month, multi stakeholder board negotiation.
You are technically fluent and can pick up how a product integrates with the systems around it, explain it accurately to a technical audience, and stay credible when the questions get detailed.
You are not put off by complexity, whether that is clinical systems, interoperability, deployment routes or information governance. You treat it as part of the sale, not someone else’s problem.
You are a strategic thinker who can build a territory plan from a blank page, defend the choices in it, and change it when the ground shifts.
You are data-led and at home in spreadsheets, CRM and reporting tools, able to turn complex information into clear priorities and a compelling pitch.
You are a self-starter who is energised rather than unnerved by an unmapped patch and no established playbook.
You are mission-driven and motivated by the chance to change how healthcare communication works across three nations at once.
What’s in it for me?
You'll be joining an established but fast-growing Tech for Good movement, where we're led by our Principles and our mission to solve healthcare productivity.

Benefits to suit you: adjust your healthcare cover, your pension or life insurance, whatever stage you’re at in life
Flexible working: We are an office first culture and ask that you’re in our (dog-friendly) Shoreditch office 3 days a week, with core hours of 10am - 4pm
Time off: You’ll get 28 days of holiday (plus bank holidays) and up to 4 weeks to work from anywhere per year

Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability.

We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.
With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.
As the Account Manager – Industrial Water & Distribution supporting North America, you will play a critical role in driving profitable growth across Arxada ’s Industrial Water business.

This highly visible commercial position combines strategic account management, distributor development, and business expansion within industrial water treatment markets, with a strong focus on the rapidly growing data center segment.

Working closely with customers, distribution partners, Technical Service, Marketing, Regulatory, Product Management, and R&D teams, you will help strengthen customer relationships, accelerate adoption of innovative water treatment technologies, and contribute directly to Arxada ’s continued growth and market leadership.
Essential Job Functions
Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic Industrial Water accounts across North America, delivering revenue growth, profitability, and customer retention.
Develop and execute strategic account plans, identify new business opportunities, and convert sales leads into sustainable revenue streams.
Lead distributor and channel partner relationships, including performance management, growth planning, and distribution optimization initiatives.
Drive market development activities within Industrial Water applications, particularly data centers, cooling water treatment, process water, and wastewater reuse.
Build strong relationships with customers, consultants, OEMs, engineering firms, service providers, and key industry influencers.
Collaborate with Technical Service, Marketing, Regulatory, Product Management, Supply Chain, and R&D teams to develop and commercialize customer-focused solutions.
Utilize Salesforce CRM to manage opportunities, forecasts, account plans, and business reviews while maintaining pipeline accuracy.
Represent Arxada at customer meetings, industry conferences, technical forums, and trade events to promote company solutions and identify growth opportunities.

Minimum 5 years of experience in technical sales, account management, or business development within industrial water treatment, specialty chemicals, antimicrobial technologies, cooling water treatment, or related markets.
Demonstrated success managing strategic accounts and delivering profitable growth.
Experience working with distributors, channel partners, and indirect sales models.
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to develop business cases, growth strategies, forecasts, and customer value propositions.
Knowledge of industrial water treatment applications and data center cooling infrastructure preferred.
Experience with biocides, antimicrobial technologies, EPA-regulated products, or water treatment chemistry is advantageous.
Bachelor's degree in chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Science, Microbiology, Water Treatment, or a related scientific discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant industry experience.

Sales at Uber means navigating ambiguity, earning trust fast, and solving problems that don't come with a script. We are looking for someone with a \"go-get-it\" attitude-someone who doesn't wait for a playbook but builds one.

Architect Account Strategy: Own and aggressively grow a portfolio of Uber's most strategically important mid-market accounts, identifying not just the obvious wins, but the complex, high-impact opportunities others miss.

Drive Commercial Excellence: Use data and market expertise to forecast with precision, identify churn risks before they happen, and prioritize your time against the highest-value activities.
Influence Without Authority: Collaborate across Product, Operations, and Marketing to unblock technical barriers and shape the future of the U4B platform based on your clients' real-world feedback.
Solve Through Ambiguity: Adapt your strategy in real-time as market dynamics shift, staying resilient through long deal cycles and the inevitable \"no\" until you find the \"yes\" that creates mutual value.
Raise the Bar: Act as a mentor and \"bar raiser\" for the wider team, sharing best practices in deal-making and account planning to help the entire Colombia hub move faster.

Systems Thinking: The ability to see the \"big picture\" of a client's business and connect Uber's digital and real-world solutions to their core financial and operational goals.

Grit and Adaptability: A history of thriving in environments where change is constant and the path to success isn't always linear.
